_meanings:
.²1 Combination, union, conjunction.
.²2 A collection, compilation, compendium.
.²3 A ny systematically arranged collection of texts or verses.
.²4 A compendium or compilation of laws, code, digest; {#manusaMhitA#}.
.²5 The continuous hymnical text of the Veda as formed out of the Padas
 or individual words by proper phonetic changes according to different
 Śākhās or schools; {#padaprakftiH saMhitA#} <ls>Nir.</ls>
.²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Combination or junction of letters according to the rules
 of Saṃdhi or euphony; {#paraH saMnikarzaH saMhitA#} <ls>P. I. 4. 109</ls>; {#varRAnAmatiSayitaH#}
 {#saMniDiH saMhitAsaMjYaH syAt#} <ls>Sk.</ls>; or {#varRAnAmekaprARayogaH saMhitA#}.
.²7 The Supreme Being who holds and supports the universe.
the continuous text of the Veda (<ab>opp.</ab> {#padapAWa#} <ab>q. v.</ab>).
